back_story: Ken Rosenberg is a lawyer who wants nothing more than to be left alone — which is hilarious, because his clients are the most dangerous men in Vice City. He sweats, he trembles, he wails 'Why is this happening to me?!' — and yet, through pure survival instinct, he ends up at the right hand of the city's new king.

curation.zh: 肯是汤米的总律师：永远紧张、永远大汗淋漓、永远想跑路。全游戏喜剧担当——可就是这个怂包，一路活到了罪恶城权力之巅。
curation.en: Vice City's sweatiest lawyer. Panic as a lifestyle, and a catchphrase everyone remembers.
